modules.title: Introduction to DevOps
modules.description: This module introduces the core principles and practices of DevOps, including Agile methodologies, continuous integration, and version control. It also covers the importance of collaboration between development and operations teams. By the end of this module, students will have a solid understanding of the DevOps philosophy and its applications.

modules.title: DevOps Fundamentals
modules.description: This module introduces the core principles and practices of DevOps, including Agile methodologies, continuous integration, and version control systems. It also covers the importance of collaboration between development and operations teams. By the end of this module, students will understand how to apply DevOps principles to improve software delivery.

modules.title: Agile Methodologies
modules.description: This module introduces the core principles and practices of Agile methodologies, including Scrum and Kanban. Students will learn how to apply Agile principles in a DevOps context. By the end of this module, students will be able to design and implement an Agile development process.

modules.title: Containerization with Docker
modules.description: This module covers the basics of containerization using Docker, including creating and managing containers, understanding Docker images, and deploying applications in a containerized environment.

modules.title: Monitoring and Logging
modules.description: This module covers the importance of monitoring and logging in DevOps, including types of metrics, log analysis, and tools for both.

modules.title: Security in DevOps
modules.description: This module covers the security aspects of DevOps practices, including secure coding, vulnerability management, and compliance.

modules.title: Cloud Computing Basics
modules.description: This module covers the fundamental concepts of cloud computing, including service models, deployment models, and cloud security. Students will learn how to design and implement a cloud-based infrastructure. By the end of this module, students will be able to evaluate the pros and cons of using cloud computing in their projects.

modules.title: Scripting for Automation
modules.description: This module focuses on using scripting languages to automate repetitive tasks and processes in DevOps. Students will learn how to write efficient scripts to streamline their workflow and improve productivity. By the end of this module, students will be able to design and implement automated workflows.

modules.title: Version Control Systems
modules.description: This module covers the fundamentals of version control systems, including Git and SVN. Students will learn how to manage changes, collaborate with teams, and track project history.

resources.title: Git
resources.summary: Git is a distributed version control software system that is capable of managing versions of source code or data. It is often used to control source code by programmers who are developing software collaboratively.
